entities.name: Théâtre des Nouveautés
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Théâtre des Nouveautés is a Parisian theatre built in 1921 and located at 24 boulevard Poissonnière. The name was also used by several earlier Parisian theatre companies and their buildings, beginning in 1827.
